archon 1.0.1 introduces new project templates and enforces better workflow state tracking.

- Added dedicated templates for project management: WBR, OKR (monthly/quarterly), risk registers, and reporting.
- Removed internal starter files for profile and org setup; templates replace starter content.
- Enforced a new workflow state tracking system using a runtime status file (`war-room/_workflow-state.md`) for all multi-step workflows.
- Updated documentation to reflect project admission rules and detailed workflow steps/outputs.
- No more Node.js validator script; all validation via templates and schemas.

Initial release of Archon – a persistent, file-based management copilot for technical managers.

- Supports structured Markdown records for logs, decisions, signals, coaching, meeting prep, reviews, and more.
- Workflows triggered by user needs, mapped to dedicated routines (archon-daily, archon-decide, etc).
- Context-aware: grounds suggestions in user profile, org context, and recent/historical files.
- All writings default to Chinese unless otherwise specified.
- Includes detailed instructions for directory structure, workflow activation, file rules, and response style.
- Packaging notes and resource references for easy setup and validation.
